@Archon AGAINST 06/02/2025 16:00
Changed the channel name: SC [AT VOTE] - Repeal "Injunct Yessss"
Personally, I’m not exactly *opposed* to this. Yes, it could go into greater detail on what exactly happened, but there are only so many ways to say “region destroyed, resolution useless, repeal”
OTOH this is about as non-time-sensitive as it gets. The region’s a trophy now
:garfield:

I believe that libjuncts are battle scars of a warzone on a region. If the battle was won, and the scars must fade for further development, sure. If the battle is over, then the scars should remain as testament to what happened

The SC has only limited few liberations and injuncts to understand and regions can’t hog them forever others need to use them too please understand [*gets whispered in her ear*] There’s how many?! Infinite!? The fuck?

(I just prefer when the SC is writing stuff that matters like the original injunct or lib - both often is just queue stuffing - and C/C and not ‘welp the timeline says its time for this to happen so time to clog the queue again’)
(Which I will call clogging since C/Cs move out of the way for those proposals)
That’s fair, though the current queue is completely empty
That’s the other thing the SC does to annoy me. Its always empty and proposals are quorate so fast. Now there’s more of us with the Commission to catch them early :BaePray:
(Wherever you see “Resolution at Vote” in the old thread names is where I got SC ninja’d :suiwheeze: )
(or where I was on LOA or gaming too hard if its on a GA thread)
@Archon vote is FOR now. This is fun, we're having fun
This is so much fun
Meaningless proposals are the worst. You can support! Or oppose! It doesn't matter!
Also Cretox, I am bestowing upon you the job of changing the WFE to reflect our votes
Perhaps meaningless is the wrong word. Milquetoast?
There’s enough support behind it to at least nicely call it low priority. As you said with the queue its a low priority time.
You should also respond to my DM Cretox :spiceclown:
What's a DM? Where am I? Who are you people?
